overall_strategy: Month 1 (cold start) plan for Winger focuses on two goals: immediate setup/durable items that improve daily comfort and safety (one-time purchases), and establishing reliable autoship for daily consumables that deplete predictably. Primary autoship: senior large-breed dry food (30-lb bag every ~4 weeks) plus daily toppers, dental chews, treats, poop bags, joint and omega supplements, ear care, pheromone refills and paw balm timed to Winger’s expected usage. One-time priorities: water fountain, elevated/slow-feeder bowl, lift/support harness, air purifier (seasonal urgency), cooling pad/orthopedic bedding, grooming tools and enrichment toys to support shorter, low-impact exercise and mental stimulation. I prioritized products that match Winger’s profile (80 lb senior Golden, medium activity, average chewer, turkey allergy) and set autoship frequencies based on realistic consumption math so you’ll avoid stockouts while minimizing waste. Adjust frequencies after the first couple of months as you see Winger’s actual usage and vet guidance.
